title: WaterColor 11 WaterColor Blvd. W #102
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 6 wristbands.- Located in WaterColor's Park District- 2-5 blocks from the beach- 1-story unit with hardwood floors throughout living, kitchen, and dining room- Furnished porch- 2 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Welcome to 11 WaterColor Blvd. W #102 is an exquisite 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condominium that sleeps 6 guests comfortably near Town Center. This remarkable unit is located in WaterColor's Park District, just a mere 2 blocks from the sprawling beach, with terrific community amenities, including a private beach club and 4 shared pools. With nearly 1,300 square feet of living space, guests will love the spacious accommodations and the surrounding parks, gardens, and footpaths.The heart of this single-story unit lies in its exquisite design and thoughtfully furnished living spaces. Hardwood floors and tasteful Floridian decor create a warm and inviting ambiance that is enhanced by the stunning views of Cerulean Park. The spacious living area boasts a 50" TV surrounded by a comfortable sectional sofa—transforming into a queen sleeper sofa for 2 extra guests—and a plush armchair with an ottoman. A modern kitchen with high-end GE appliances and ample counter space makes cooking a pleasure for the whole family, while the nearby dining room seats 6 around a charming table to enjoy a home-cooked meal together. The primary bedroom features a luxurious king bed and a private bathroom with a 39" TV for entertainment. The guest bedroom offers a plush queen-sized bed and a 39" TV, ensuring guests feel at home during their stay. With 2 furnished porches off the living room, this unit provides the perfect spot to enjoy a morning coffee or evening glass of wine with stunning views of the park's greenspace. This home is a captivating haven of elegance and comfort.11 WaterColor Blvd. W #102 truly delights the senses with wonderful WaterColor amenities in a great location. With on-site parking in the parking lot—plus 2 complimentary adult bikes—take a short walk or bike ride to the WaterColor Boat House and Beach Club. Enjoy access to multiple beaches, including Van Ness Butler and Santa Clara. Book this incredible property today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 6):- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Living Room: Queen Sleeper*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
